Sections of code that are entirely or mostly generated by AI should be marked with a comment header and footer that includes the AI engine used and stating the code was AI.

The fix was implemented with assistance from GitHub Copilot. The changes are minimal (3 lines modified, 3 lines removed) and follow standard PHP null coalescing operator patterns.

author: alalazo
body: This PR is part of an on-going effort to speed up the solver. The commits are all independent, so they may be rebased and merged, rather than squashed. The optimizations here are mostly aimed at reducing the size of the grounded problem. In particular: 1. The `condition_nodes/3` facts have been decoupled from the `TriggerID` and turned into `condition_nodes/2`. This reduces the amount of grounded rules considerably. 2. The conflict rule has been split, to avoid in most cases an expensive join over unification sets Besides that, the heuristics has been reworked, and we started using "levels". This allow us to force a clear order over priorities of the guesses in the solver. Results are the following: [radiuss.develop.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23651970/radiuss.develop.csv) [radiuss.pr.usc.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23660031/radiuss.pr.usc.csv) We can experiment further with heuristics in following PRs, but this seems a promising starting point.

author: rrebollo
body:
Fixes #451

This PR contains **two commits**:

1. **Adds a test** that reproduces the issue.  
2. **Introduces a proposed fix** for the issue.

### 🧩 Context

The problem occurs in the following workflow:

1. Sell a kit.  
2. Confirm the Sales Order (SO).  
3. Validate the related picking.  
4. Return the picking.  
5. Cancel the SO.  
6. Set the SO back to draft.  
7. Confirm the SO again.

At this point, the system generate another picking and you validate this too, and we noticed that the **kit component quantities** shown on the **delivery slip report** were incorrect.

### 🔍 Root Cause

The issue appears to stem from the calculation of the **component quantities per kit** during this sequence of operations.

### 🛠️ Proposed Fix

This PR provides an initial attempt to resolve the incorrect quantity computation. Additional details and discussion can be found in the linked issue.

author: codewizwit
body:
## Summary

Adds comprehensive **Skills architecture** for dual-platform AI assistance with native Claude Code and GitHub Copilot integration.

This replaces context packs for framework-specific expertise and provides platform-native formats for automatic activation in both Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

## What's Included

### Skills Architecture (`lib/skills/`)

Framework-specific expertise with dual-format support:
- **claude-skill.md** - Claude Code format with YAML frontmatter
- **copilot-instructions.md** - GitHub Copilot format with applyTo patterns
- **metadata.json** - CLI metadata for discovery and installation
- **README.md** - Comprehensive documentation with examples

**Installation Options:**
```bash
# Install for Claude Code
hit install skill/angular-modern --as-skill

# Install for GitHub Copilot
hit install skill/angular-modern --as-copilot

# Install as documentation
hit install skill/angular-modern
```

### Angular Modern Skill ✅

**Angular 16+ development** with modern reactive primitives:

**Key Features:**
- ✅ **Signals for State** - signal(), computed(), effect()
- ✅ **Standalone Components** - No NgModules required
- ✅ **Signal-Based I/O** - input(), output() instead of decorators
- ✅ **Control Flow Syntax** - @if, @for, @switch instead of structural directives
- ✅ **Resource API** - New data loading patterns (Angular 19+)
- ✅ **Service-Level State** - Global state management with signals
- ✅ **Component Testing** - TestBed patterns for signal-based components

**Content:**
- 800+ line skill with comprehensive examples
- 20+ code examples showing modern patterns
- Best practices and anti-patterns with ✅/❌ indicators
- Migration guidance from RxJS to signals

**Files:**
- `lib/skills/angular-modern/claude-skill.md` (22KB)
- `lib/skills/angular-modern/copilot-instructions.md` (8KB)
- `lib/skills/angular-modern/metadata.json`
- `lib/skills/angular-modern/README.md`

### Angular Legacy Skill ✅

**Pre-Angular 16** patterns for maintaining legacy applications:

**Key Features:**
- ✅ **NgModule Architecture** - Feature modules, shared modules
- ✅ **Lifecycle Hooks** - ngOnInit, ngOnChanges, ngOnDestroy patterns
- ✅ **@Input/@Output Decorators** - Component communication
- ✅ **Structural Directives** - *ngIf, *ngFor, *ngSwitch
- ✅ **RxJS Observables** - State management with BehaviorSubject
- ✅ **Change Detection** - OnPush vs Default strategies
- ✅ **Subscription Management** - takeUntil pattern for cleanup

**Content:**
- 700+ line skill with legacy patterns
- 15+ code examples showing NgModule-based architecture
- Subscription management best practices
- Testing patterns for observable-based components

**Files:**
- `lib/skills/angular-legacy/claude-skill.md` (19KB)
- `lib/skills/angular-legacy/copilot-instructions.md` (6KB)
- `lib/skills/angular-legacy/metadata.json`
- `lib/skills/angular-legacy/README.md`

### CLI Updates

**lib-scanner.ts** updated to support skills:
- Added `'skill'` to Tool type enum
- Added `'skills'` directory scanning
- Added `metadata.json` parsing (JSON format)
- Backward compatible with existing prompts/agents/evaluators/guardrails

### Documentation Updates

**Updated Files:**
- ✅ `README.md` - Added Skills section, updated repo structure
- ✅ `lib/README.md` - Added skills to directory structure
- ✅ `lib/context-packs/README.md` - Clarified context packs vs skills
- ✅ `lib/skills/README.md` - Comprehensive guide (570 lines)

**New Claude Code Skills** (`.claude/skills/`):
- `angular-modern.md` - For developing this project with modern Angular
- `angular-legacy.md` - For maintaining legacy code in this project
- `nestjs-expert.md`, `nx-monorepo-expert.md` - For our development workflow

## Skills vs Context Packs

| Aspect | Skills | Context Packs |
|--------|--------|---------------|
| **Purpose** | Framework-specific expertise | Cross-cutting patterns |
| **Format** | Native markdown for Claude/Copilot | Documentation & guides |
| **Integration** | Automatic activation | Manual loading |
| **Examples** | Angular, NestJS, Nx | Security, testing, deployment |

**Migration:**
- `lib/context-packs/angular/` → `lib/skills/angular-modern/` + `lib/skills/angular-legacy/`
- Context packs remain for cross-cutting concerns (security, testing, deployment)

## Technical Details

### Dual-Platform Support

**Claude Code Format:**
```markdown
---
name: angular-modern
description: Apply modern Angular patterns with signals...
---

# Angular Modern Skill

## When to Activate
- Working with Angular 16+ projects
- Using signals, computed, effect
...
```

**GitHub Copilot Format:**
```markdown
---
applyTo: '**/*.ts,**/*.component.ts,**/*.service.ts,**/*.html'
---

# Angular Modern Development

## Core Principles
1. Use signals for state
2. Use standalone components
...
```

### Metadata Format

```json
{
  "id": "angular-modern",
  "name": "Angular Modern",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "skill",
  "description": "Modern Angular development with signals...",
  "category": "framework",
  "tags": ["angular", "signals", "standalone"],
  "platforms": ["claude-code", "github-copilot"],
  "metadata": {
    "author": "Human-in-the-Loop",
    "license": "MIT",
    "frameworks": ["angular"]
  },
  "minAngularVersion": "16.0.0"
}
```

## Test plan

- [x] All quality checks passed:
  - [x] `pnpm format` - All files formatted with Prettier
  - [x] `pnpm lint` - ESLint checks passed
  - [x] `pnpm typecheck` - TypeScript compilation successful
  - [x] `pnpm build` - Project built successfully
  - [x] Skills included in dist output
- [x] Code quality standards met:
  - [x] TypeScript strict mode compliance
  - [x] TypeDoc comments on all exported functions
  - [x] No inline comments in source code
  - [x] Proper error handling
- [x] Documentation complete:
  - [x] All READMEs updated
  - [x] Repository structure diagrams current
  - [x] Skills README comprehensive (570 lines)
  - [x] Installation examples included

## Alignment with Project Goals

**Addresses:**
- Issue #19 (Angular Context Pack) - Replaced with dual Angular skills
- Skills roadmap planning (Angular Modern/Legacy split)

**Benefits:**
- ✅ **Dual-Platform Support** - Works with both Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
- ✅ **Automatic Activation** - Skills trigger automatically based on file patterns
- ✅ **Version-Specific** - Separate skills for modern vs legacy Angular
- ✅ **Real-Time Assistance** - No manual loading, always available
- ✅ **Searchable** - CLI supports `hit search "angular"`
- ✅ **Extensible** - Framework ready for NestJS, Nx, React, etc.

## Use Cases

1. **Modern Angular Development** - Install `angular-modern` skill
2. **Legacy Maintenance** - Install `angular-legacy` skill
3. **Learning** - Install as documentation for reference
4. **Team Onboarding** - Share skills for consistent patterns
5. **Multi-Platform** - Use same expertise in Claude Code and Copilot

## Example Workflow

```bash
# Search for Angular skills
hit search "angular"

# Install for Claude Code
hit install skill/angular-modern --as-skill

# Install for GitHub Copilot
hit install skill/angular-modern --as-copilot

# Both platforms now have Angular Modern expertise!
```

## Breaking Changes

None - This is additive functionality. Existing prompts, agents, and context packs continue to work.

## Related Issues

- Closes #19 (Angular Context Pack)
- Supports future #20 (NestJS), #21 (Nx Monorepo) with same pattern
